title: Wan-Alpha++: Animating a Single RGBA Asset into Controllable Transparent Video Effects
title_zh: Wan-Alpha++：将单个RGBA资产动画化为可控的透明视频效果

paragraphs.en: Wan-Alpha++提出统一RGBA视频生成框架，通过共享潜在空间实现文本和图像条件下的可控透明视频效果生成。 RGBA video generation is essential for creating compositable visual assets in filmmaking, game development, and digital content production. However, generating high-quality RGB appearance alongside temporally coherent transparency remains a significant challenge. Existing text-to-RGBA video methods often entangle RGB and alpha distributions and offer limited control over the precise appearance of a target asset. In addition, incorporating image conditioning typically suffers from the emergence-disappearance effects, which fail existing first-frame or first-and-last-frame conditions due to their fully transparent boundary frames. To address these issues, we present Wan-Alpha++, a unified framework that brings controllable RGBA video generation to both text- and image-to-video diffusion backbones through a shared RGBA latent space, extending our conference version Wan-Alpha from the text-conditioned setting to image-conditioned generation with an interior reference frame. Our method first learns shiftable RGB-alpha distributions while preserving the pretrained RGB prior. Specifically, we introduce a transparency-aware bidirectional diffusion objective to produce distinguishable RGBA latent representations, and a transparency-guided mean sampler that shifts the noise distribution to improve transparency generation and enable spatial controllability. Building upon this RGBA generation prior, we introduce temporal phase reparameterization for image-conditioned effect generation. By cyclically transforming a zero-positive-zero alpha pattern into a positive-zero-positive pattern, it relocates visible content to both temporal boundaries, facilitating effective appearance conditioning with limited RGBA data.
paragraphs.zh: Wan-Alpha++ 提出统一的 RGBA 视频生成框架，通过共享潜在空间实现文本和图像条件下的可控透明视频效果生成。RGBA 视频生成对于在电影制作、游戏开发和数字内容生产中创建可合成的视觉素材至关重要。 然而，同时生成高质量的 RGB 外观与时间上连贯的透明度仍然是一个重大挑战。 现有的文本到 RGBA 视频方法往往将 RGB 与 alpha 分布纠缠在一起，并且对目标素材的精确外观提供的控制十分有限。 此外，引入图像条件通常会遭遇出现-消失效应，由于首帧或首尾帧条件下的边界帧完全透明，现有方法无法应对这些问题。 为解决这些问题，我们提出 Wan-Alpha++，这是一个统一框架，通过共享的 RGBA 潜在空间为文本到视频和图像到视频的扩散主干带来可控的 RGBA 视频生成；它将我们的会议版本 Wan-Alpha 从文本条件设置扩展到采用内部参考帧的图像条件生成。 我们的方法首先学习可平移的 RGB-alpha 分布，同时保留预训练的 RGB 先验。 具体而言，我们引入透明度感知的双向扩散目标以产生可区分的 RGBA 潜在表示，并引入透明度引导的均值采样器，通过平移噪声分布来改进透明度生成并实现空间可控性。 在这一 RGBA 生成先验的基础上，我们为图像条件下的效果生成引入了时间相位重参数化。 通过将零-正-零的 alpha 模式循环变换为正-零-正的模式，它将可见内容重新定位到两个时间边界，从而在有限的 RGBA 数据下实现有效的外观条件控制。
